purpose: Independent external validation of whether source-year quantitative Thalassia meadow state predicts next-year recorded loss.

relationship_to_tampa_discovery.frozen_hypothesis: Among annual station-years with recorded Thalassia presence, lower source-year within-station frequency and abundance add out-of-time information about next-year recorded loss beyond a conventional space/time/effort baseline.

source.data_request: HTTP content negotiation with Accept: text/tab-separated-values
source.stated_protocol: 12 quadrats along each of three transects/stations per location

parser_contract.node_id: normalized Loc ID + '::' + normalized Stat ID
parser_contract.date: ISO-compatible Date/Time; calendar year used for annualization
parser_contract.quadrat_sample_id: node_id + exact Date/Time + quadrat-number field at column 9, falling back to column 10 only when column 9 is empty
parser_contract.focal_taxon_match: case-insensitive whitespace-normalized scientific-name substring 'thalassia testudinum' OR WoRMS AphiaID 374720 / LSID taxname:374720 in the concatenation of columns 11-13
parser_contract.focal_cover: column 14; focal rows must contain a finite numeric percent-cover value between 0 and 100 inclusive
parser_contract.duplicate_focal_quadrat: terminal stop if more than one focal row maps to the same quadrat sample
parser_contract.node_geometry: median latitude/longitude per node; stop if either coordinate span exceeds 0.01 degree within node

annual_state.recorded_presence: at least one focal quadrat sample with Thalassia cover > 0 during that station-year
annual_state.frequency: number of focal-positive quadrat samples / number of all unique sampled quadrats in station-year
annual_state.abundance: sum of focal percent cover across unique focal quadrat samples / number of all unique sampled quadrats in station-year; quadrats without focal record contribute zero
annual_state.multiple_surveys: all surveys within a station-year are pooled before state construction

transition_endpoint.target: same stable station in the immediately following calendar year
transition_endpoint.interpretation: recorded-state transition only; never demographic extinction/survival

model.split: strict walk-forward by target calendar year; target year y trains only on transitions with target year < y
model.numeric_scaling: StandardScaler fit on each training set only
model.categorical_encoding: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') fit on each training set only

secondary: ROC AUC when pooled labels contain both classes
scoring.aggregation: unweighted mean of scored target-year log losses
scoring.favorable: augmented macro log loss < baseline AND augmented wins >= ceil(0.60 * scored target years)
scoring.adverse: baseline macro log loss < augmented AND baseline wins >= ceil(0.60 * scored target years)

no_rescue_rules: Do not change focal taxon after data access.
Do not change annualization, transition endpoint, predictors, learner, training gate, scoring metric, or decision rule after data access.
Do not lower estimability minima after data access.
Do not replace percent cover with canopy height or biomass to rescue a result.
Do not drop a country, location, station, year, or adverse target year based on observed outcome.
Parser/schema failure after data access terminates v1; any repair requires a separately versioned future protocol and cannot be called the same independent validation.
